text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out with Narita
Brian...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Huh, plushies... Reminds me a bit of the
old days.

I follow Narita Brian's gaze to a claw
machine
filled with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I had a plushie like that when I was little.
...My big
sis and I used to have matching
ones.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Not in plushies, and certainly not in claw

machines.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...How so? It's just a game, right?
choice_data_list: クレーンゲームも結構奥が深いぞ

choice_data_list_en: Crane games are actually pretty deep, you know.
Crane games are actually pretty deep, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Then show me. Let's see what this
claw
machine thing is all about.
choice_data_list: 間合いを見切る鋭い感覚が要るんだ
間合いを見切る鋭い感覚が要るよ
choice_data_list_en: You need sharp instincts to gauge the distance.
You'll need sharp instincts to gauge the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking the trouble to watch, so don't
waste my
time with anything but your
best.
There's no way I can fail now!
